verdict.rationale: ClickUp explicitly advertises an 'Automations' feature and the ability to 'Trigger workflows from ClickUp events,' which supports building automated recurring workflows for routine team tasks, but the evidence never specifically confirms schedule-based (time/cron) triggers or recurring-event automation details. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of schedule/time-based triggers, recurring automation examples, and independent/hands-on confirmation that automations run reliably on a schedule.
